items.summary: The FCC plans to open 1,050 MHz in the 12.7 GHz and 42 GHz bands to expanded satellite use, adding capacity for broadband, mobile connectivity, inter-satellite links and ground networks.

items.title: IEEE CSCN 2026 Workshop Explores How 6G Can Empower Polyfunctional Robotics
items.summary: On September 9, 2026, experts from across academia, industry, and the standardization community gathered at the IEEE Conference on Standards for Communications and Networking (IEEE CSCN 2026) in London for the workshop on “6G Empowering Polyfunctional Robotics.” […] The post IEEE CSCN 2026 Workshop Explores How 6G Can...

items.title: 4iG and SpaceX Plan Starlink Mobile Rollout Across Hungary and Western Balkans
items.summary: 4iG and SpaceX plan direct-to-device Starlink services across four European markets, alongside secured government communications, but national spectrum approvals and key details of the proposed sovereign infrastructure remain unresolved.

items.title: Starlink’s Unconventional Approach to Cellular
items.summary: SpaceX is considering a terrestrial cellular network powered by Starlink satellite backhaul, but scarce spectrum, enormous capacity demands and entrenched rivals could make its boldest telecommunications gambit yet far harder to execute profitably at scale.

items.title: Starlink Mobile faces consumer resistance, survey says
items.summary: A TD Cowen survey found limited consumer interest in Starlink Mobile – and Verizon reclaimed the top carrier brand ranking from T-Mobile.

items.title: Indoor cellular experts ponder SpaceX’s entry into wireless
items.summary: SpaceX may shake up wireless with a hybrid satellite-terrestrial network, but indoor connectivity remains a challenge.

items.title: Huawei and Qualcomm Announce Broad Patent License Agreement
items.summary: Huawei and Qualcomm have announced a multi-year, broad patent license agreement that includes cross licenses to the companies' patent portfolios across a range of fields, including 5G, compute, AI, and networking, together with Qualcomm's purchase of certain Huawei U.S. patents.

items.title: Upstream surge reshaping cable operators’ priorities
items.summary: As cable operators push DOCSIS networks harder and expand fiber footprints, OpenVault says the industry’s biggest challenge is no longer downstream capacity but managing growing upstream demand, network health and operational efficiency.

items.title: SpaceX scores 15K-satellite win as FCC doubles down on D2D
items.summary: SpaceX is getting a lot more support from the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) for Elon Musk's quest to more aggressively challenge the Big 3 mobile carriers in the U.S.

items.title: Opinion: Can carriers finally move up the stack? AT&T, Cisco and NVIDIA say AI changes the equation
items.summary: Connectivity gets operators into the game, but compute, security and control could move them up the stack.

items.title: AT&T and 2 equity partners create new fiber broadband joint venture
items.summary: AT&T already has Gigapower and Forged Fiber 37. Now, these will be combined with investments from equity partners Global Infrastructure Partners and CPP Investments.

items.title: RNP selects Nokia and Q13 to modernize Brazil's research and education network
items.summary: The new secure, automated and high-performance IP network will connect more than four million users and will provide the foundation for AI-enabled research, scientific discovery and digital innovation across Brazil.

items.title: Vodafone selects CUJO AI to detect quality of outcome in its broadband networks
items.summary: Rather than assessing a network primarily through technical measures, QoO evaluates how well network conditions support the outcomes users expect from specific applications.

items.title: Telstra lights Perth-Sydney fiber route to bolster Australia’s digital backbone
items.summary: Telstra’s Aura Network just got a major east-west boost, giving AI, cloud and data center players another high-capacity path across Australia.

items.title: T-Mobile showcases AI wins at DT’s investor event
items.summary: T-Mobile showed how DT’s AI ambitions are already delivering gains in customer care, network automation and cost savings.

items.title: UK's Openreach taps Ciena's WaveLogic 6 to deliver 800G
items.summary: Openreach is using Ciena’s newest optical tech to bring national 800G services to UK wholesale customers chasing more capacity for AI, cloud, data centers and subsea traffic.
